# David Eiken

> Senior Frontend Engineer with an AI-native workflow, based in Minden, Germany. 30 years of experience in digital media, from print to full-stack web development. Today, AI agents write the code; David owns architecture, UX and quality. Available immediately – remote in Germany, hybrid and DACH on request.

Formerly known as David Maciejewski. Focus areas: AI-native frontend engineering (spec-driven development, context engineering, multi-agent orchestration, agent skills, MCP), semantic HTML and accessibility, frustration-free UX, design systems. Technology-agnostic: Angular, React, Vue.js, Astro and others. Lecturer at HAWK Hildesheim for 11 years (~660 students), podcast pioneer since 2005 (Technikwürze). Languages: German (native), English.
